dialogue.text: Late on the evening of October 29, 1969, a UCLA grad student named Charlie Klein pulled on a headset, got Stanford on the line, about 400 miles up the coast, and sat down at a terminal to try something nobody had pulled off before.
dialogue.zh: 1969年10月29日深夜，一位名叫查理·克萊因的UCLA研究生戴上耳機，撥通了位於海岸線約400英里外的斯坦福大學，然後坐在終端機前嘗試一件從未有人成功過的事。
dialogue.ja: 1969年10月29日の夜遅く、UCLAの大学院生チャーリー・クラインはヘッドセットをつけ、約400マイル離れた海岸沿いのスタンフォードと電話をつなぎ、誰も成功させたことのない試みをするために端末の前に座りました。
dialogue.local: Late on the evening of October 29, 1969, a UCLA grad student named Charlie Klein pulled on a headset, got Stanford on the line, about 400 miles up the coast, and sat down at a terminal to try something nobody had pulled off before.
dialogue.en: Late on the evening of October 29, 1969, a UCLA grad student named Charlie Klein pulled on a headset, got Stanford on the line, about 400 miles up the coast, and sat down at a terminal to try something nobody had pulled off before.

dialogue.text: The plan?
dialogue.zh: 計劃是？
dialogue.ja: 計画は？
dialogue.local: The plan?
dialogue.en: The plan?

dialogue.text: Stupidly simple, really.
dialogue.zh: 其實非常簡單。
dialogue.ja: 実に単純なものでした。
dialogue.local: Stupidly simple, really.
dialogue.en: Stupidly simple, really.

dialogue.text: Type login.
dialogue.zh: 輸入 login。
dialogue.ja: ログインと入力する。
dialogue.local: Type login.
dialogue.en: Type login.

dialogue.text: See if it lands on a screen way up north.
dialogue.zh: 看看它是否會出現在北方的螢幕上。
dialogue.ja: 北の方の画面に表示されるかどうかを確認する。
dialogue.local: See if it lands on a screen way up north.
dialogue.en: See if it lands on a screen way up north.

dialogue.text: That was it.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。
dialogue.ja: それだけでした。
dialogue.local: That was it.
dialogue.en: That was it.

dialogue.text: That was the whole test.
dialogue.zh: 這就是整個測試。
dialogue.ja: それが全てのテストでした。
dialogue.local: That was the whole test.
dialogue.en: That was the whole test.

dialogue.text: Nobody involved was entirely sure it would work.
dialogue.zh: 參與的人都不完全確定它會成功。
dialogue.ja: 関わった誰もが、それがうまくいくか完全には確信していませんでした。
dialogue.local: Nobody involved was entirely sure it would work.
dialogue.en: Nobody involved was entirely sure it would work.

dialogue.text: At the time, computers simply didn't talk to each other.
dialogue.zh: 當時，電腦根本不會互相通訊。
dialogue.ja: 当時、コンピューター同士は単純に通信していませんでした。
dialogue.local: At the time, computers simply didn't talk to each other.
dialogue.en: At the time, computers simply didn't talk to each other.

dialogue.text: Each one was its own closed world.
dialogue.zh: 每台電腦都是獨立封閉的世界。
dialogue.ja: それぞれが独立した閉じた世界でした。
dialogue.local: Each one was its own closed world.
dialogue.en: Each one was its own closed world.

dialogue.text: If a scientist in California needed information, sitting on a machine in Massachusetts, there was no way to just ask for it remotely.
dialogue.zh: 如果加州的科學家需要馬薩諸塞州機器上的資訊，根本無法遠端請求。
dialogue.ja: カリフォルニアの科学者がマサチューセッツのコンピューターにある情報を必要としても、遠隔でただ要求する方法はありませんでした。
dialogue.local: If a scientist in California needed information, sitting on a machine in Massachusetts, there was no way to just ask for it remotely.
dialogue.en: If a scientist in California needed information, sitting on a machine in Massachusetts, there was no way to just ask for it remotely.

dialogue.text: You shipped a tape in the mail and waited.
dialogue.zh: 你只能寄送磁帶並等待回覆。
dialogue.ja: テープを郵送して待つしかありませんでした。
dialogue.local: You shipped a tape in the mail and waited.
dialogue.en: You shipped a tape in the mail and waited.

dialogue.text: It sounds primitive now, but that was the everyday reality of computing.
dialogue.zh: 現在聽起來很原始，但那是當時電腦運作的日常現實。
dialogue.ja: 今では原始的に聞こえますが、それが当時のコンピューティングの現実でした。
dialogue.local: It sounds primitive now, but that was the everyday reality of computing.
dialogue.en: It sounds primitive now, but that was the everyday reality of computing.

dialogue.text: Klein typed L. It appeared on the Stanford machine.
dialogue.zh: 克萊因打了L，斯坦福的機器上出現了L。
dialogue.ja: クラインはLと打ち、スタンフォードのコンピューターに表示されました。
dialogue.local: Klein typed L. It appeared on the Stanford machine.
dialogue.en: Klein typed L. It appeared on the Stanford machine.

dialogue.text: He typed O.
dialogue.zh: 他打了O。
dialogue.ja: 彼はOと打ちました。
dialogue.local: He typed O.
dialogue.en: He typed O.

dialogue.text: Then, right as he typed G, the system crashed.
dialogue.zh: 然後，就在他打G的時候，系統當機了。
dialogue.ja: そして、彼がGと打った瞬間、システムがクラッシュしました。
dialogue.local: Then, right as he typed G, the system crashed.
dialogue.en: Then, right as he typed G, the system crashed.

dialogue.text: So the very first message ever sent across a computer network wasn't login at all.
dialogue.zh: 所以，第一個透過電腦網路傳送的訊息根本不是login。
dialogue.ja: つまり、コンピューターネットワークを通じて送られた最初のメッセージは、実は「login」ではありませんでした。
dialogue.local: So the very first message ever sent across a computer network wasn't login at all.
dialogue.en: So the very first message ever sent across a computer network wasn't login at all.

dialogue.text: It was just L.O., half a word, cut short by a technical failure.
dialogue.zh: 它只是L.O.，半個字，被技術故障中斷了。
dialogue.ja: それは単に「L.O.」という半分の言葉で、技術的な故障で途中で切れてしまいました。
dialogue.local: It was just L.O., half a word, cut short by a technical failure.
dialogue.en: It was just L.O., half a word, cut short by a technical failure.

dialogue.text: In hindsight, there's something almost poetic about that.
dialogue.zh: 事後看來，這件事幾乎帶有詩意。
dialogue.ja: 振り返ると、それにはほとんど詩的な何かがあります。
dialogue.local: In hindsight, there's something almost poetic about that.
dialogue.en: In hindsight, there's something almost poetic about that.

dialogue.text: The first thing the internet ever said to itself was an accident.
dialogue.zh: 網際網路對自己說的第一句話是一場意外。
dialogue.ja: インターネットが最初に自分自身に言ったことは、偶然の事故でした。
dialogue.local: The first thing the internet ever said to itself was an accident.
dialogue.en: The first thing the internet ever said to itself was an accident.

dialogue.text: The crash was resolved within the hour, and the full word went through cleanly the second time.
dialogue.zh: 當機在一小時內解決，第二次完整的字成功傳送。
dialogue.ja: クラッシュは1時間以内に解決され、2回目には完全な単語が問題なく送信されました。
dialogue.local: The crash was resolved within the hour, and the full word went through cleanly the second time.
dialogue.en: The crash was resolved within the hour, and the full word went through cleanly the second time.

dialogue.text: Nobody threw a party.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人舉辦慶祝派對。
dialogue.ja: 誰もパーティーを開きませんでした。
dialogue.local: Nobody threw a party.
dialogue.en: Nobody threw a party.

dialogue.text: There was no press release.
dialogue.zh: 也沒有新聞稿。
dialogue.ja: プレスリリースもありませんでした。
dialogue.local: There was no press release.
dialogue.en: There was no press release.

dialogue.text: A small group of engineers simply understood that something they'd been building toward had finally worked.
dialogue.zh: 一小群工程師只是明白他們一直努力建造的東西終於成功了。
dialogue.ja: 少数のエンジニアたちが、自分たちが作り上げてきたものがついに成功したことを理解しただけでした。
dialogue.local: A small group of engineers simply understood that something they'd been building toward had finally worked.
dialogue.en: A small group of engineers simply understood that something they'd been building toward had finally worked.

dialogue.text: That network was called ARPANET, funded by the Department of Defense with a fairly narrow goal.
dialogue.zh: 那個網路叫做ARPANET，由國防部資助，目標相當明確。
dialogue.ja: そのネットワークはARPANETと呼ばれ、国防総省によって比較的狭い目的で資金提供されていました。
dialogue.local: That network was called ARPANET, funded by the Department of Defense with a fairly narrow goal.
dialogue.en: That network was called ARPANET, funded by the Department of Defense with a fairly narrow goal.

dialogue.text: Let a handful of expensive research computers share resources with each other, and keep functioning even if one connection dropped.
dialogue.zh: 讓少數昂貴的研究電腦彼此共享資源，即使一個連線中斷也能繼續運作。
dialogue.ja: 高価な研究用コンピューター数台が資源を共有し、一つの接続が切れても機能し続けるようにすることでした。
dialogue.local: Let a handful of expensive research computers share resources with each other, and keep functioning even if one connection dropped.
dialogue.en: Let a handful of expensive research computers share resources with each other, and keep functioning even if one connection dropped.

dialogue.text: By the close of 1969, exactly four computers were on it, at UCLA, Stanford, UC Santa Barbara, and the University of Utah.
dialogue.zh: 到1969年底，ARPANET上有四台電腦，分別在UCLA、斯坦福、加州大學聖塔芭芭拉分校和猶他大學。
dialogue.ja: 1969年末までに、UCLA、スタンフォード、カリフォルニア大学サンタバーバラ校、ユタ大学の4台のコンピューターが接続されていました。
dialogue.local: By the close of 1969, exactly four computers were on it, at UCLA, Stanford, UC Santa Barbara, and the University of Utah.
dialogue.en: By the close of 1969, exactly four computers were on it, at UCLA, Stanford, UC Santa Barbara, and the University of Utah.

dialogue.text: That was the entire internet.
dialogue.zh: 那就是整個網際網路。
dialogue.ja: それがインターネットの全てでした。
dialogue.local: That was the entire internet.
dialogue.en: That was the entire internet.

dialogue.text: Four machines, in four rooms, tied together by a fragile experimental connection.
dialogue.zh: 四台機器，分別在四個房間，透過脆弱的實驗性連線連結。
dialogue.ja: 4台の機械が4つの部屋にあり、壊れやすい実験的な接続で結ばれていました。
dialogue.local: Four machines, in four rooms, tied together by a fragile experimental connection.
dialogue.en: Four machines, in four rooms, tied together by a fragile experimental connection.

dialogue.text: None of what came later existed yet.
dialogue.zh: 後來的東西都還不存在。
dialogue.ja: 後に登場するものはまだ存在していませんでした。
dialogue.local: None of what came later existed yet.
dialogue.en: None of what came later existed yet.

dialogue.text: No email, no websites, no browsers.
dialogue.zh: 沒有電子郵件，沒有網站，沒有瀏覽器。
dialogue.ja: メールもウェブサイトもブラウザもありませんでした。
dialogue.local: No email, no websites, no browsers.
dialogue.en: No email, no websites, no browsers.

dialogue.text: Just small packets of data finding their way between a handful of machines, one glitch away from going silent.
dialogue.zh: 只有少量資料包在幾台機器間傳遞，隨時可能因故障而中斷。
dialogue.ja: 少数の機械間で小さなデータパケットが行き来しているだけで、ちょっとしたトラブルで通信が途絶える可能性がありました。
dialogue.local: Just small packets of data finding their way between a handful of machines, one glitch away from going silent.
dialogue.en: Just small packets of data finding their way between a handful of machines, one glitch away from going silent.

dialogue.text: But the underlying idea had been proven, and that idea turned out to be the important part.
dialogue.zh: 但基本的想法已被證明，而這個想法才是重要的部分。
dialogue.ja: しかし、根本的なアイデアは証明され、それが重要な部分であることがわかりました。
dialogue.local: But the underlying idea had been proven, and that idea turned out to be the important part.
dialogue.en: But the underlying idea had been proven, and that idea turned out to be the important part.

dialogue.text: Machines could communicate across distance using a shared set of rules, and once that was true, everything else became a matter of time.
dialogue.zh: 機器能透過一套共用規則跨距離通訊，一旦這點成立，其他一切只是時間問題。
dialogue.ja: 機械は共通のルールを使って遠く離れた場所でも通信できるようになり、それが実現すればあとは時間の問題でした。
dialogue.local: Machines could communicate across distance using a shared set of rules, and once that was true, everything else became a matter of time.
dialogue.en: Machines could communicate across distance using a shared set of rules, and once that was true, everything else became a matter of time.

dialogue.text: Email arrived in the early 70s.
dialogue.zh: 電子郵件在70年代初出現。
dialogue.ja: 電子メールは70年代初頭に登場しました。
dialogue.local: Email arrived in the early 70s.
dialogue.en: Email arrived in the early 70s.

dialogue.text: A common protocol called TCP/IP eventually stitched separate networks into one larger system.
dialogue.zh: 一種叫做TCP/IP的通用協定最終將不同網路串接成一個更大的系統。
dialogue.ja: TCP/IPという共通のプロトコルが最終的に別々のネットワークを一つの大きなシステムに繋ぎました。
dialogue.local: A common protocol called TCP/IP eventually stitched separate networks into one larger system.
dialogue.en: A common protocol called TCP/IP eventually stitched separate networks into one larger system.

dialogue.text: Two decades later, the worldwide web was built on top of all of it.
dialogue.zh: 二十年後，全球資訊網建立在這一切之上。
dialogue.ja: 20年後、ワールドワイドウェブがその上に構築されました。
dialogue.local: Two decades later, the worldwide web was built on top of all of it.
dialogue.en: Two decades later, the worldwide web was built on top of all of it.

dialogue.text: So the next time a page loads instantly or a message crosses the planet in a second, it's worth remembering where that started.
dialogue.zh: 所以，下次當網頁瞬間載入或訊息瞬間傳遍全球時，值得記得這一切的起點。
dialogue.ja: だから次にページが瞬時に読み込まれたり、メッセージが一瞬で地球を駆け巡ったりするとき、その始まりを思い出す価値があります。
dialogue.local: So the next time a page loads instantly or a message crosses the planet in a second, it's worth remembering where that started.
dialogue.en: So the next time a page loads instantly or a message crosses the planet in a second, it's worth remembering where that started.

dialogue.text: Not in a lab full of engineers celebrating a breakthrough, but in one crashed, two-letter message, typed by a student who was just hoping the phone line would hold.
dialogue.zh: 不是在一個充滿工程師慶祝突破的實驗室，而是在一則當機的兩個字母訊息中，由一位只希望電話線能穩定的學生打出。
dialogue.ja: エンジニアが突破を祝う研究室ではなく、電話回線が持つことを願う学生が打った、クラッシュした2文字のメッセージの中にありました。
dialogue.local: Not in a lab full of engineers celebrating a breakthrough, but in one crashed, two-letter message, typed by a student who was just hoping the phone line would hold.
dialogue.en: Not in a lab full of engineers celebrating a breakthrough, but in one crashed, two-letter message, typed by a student who was just hoping the phone line would hold.
